text.text: The Wizard Armor is this mod's part-based armor set. All four pieces (hat / robe / leggings / boots) are built the same way: at the Tinkers' Anvil from plating + maille + robe lace, consuming one magic cloth as well.
Armor value comes from the material in the plating slot; the other parts add durability and their own armor traits, so every piece can mix materials freely.

Every piece carries the same three exclusive traits (no levels, independent of materials): Mana Surge, Mana Shield and All Paths Are One. They live in the tool definition, so only armor that still has the traits keeps the effects - wash a trait off with a modifier crystal and its bonus goes with it.
This section is supplied by our own book repository and is attached to both Materials and You and the Encyclopedia, showing up next to the stock Tinkers' chapters in either book.
